answer: Admission auction: each epoch only a fixed number of new identity slots is auctioned, so no one can mint identities at will. Bidders post a bond; the highest win and the bond locks for 20 epochs, winners listed in an atlas. Honest newcomers get the bond back; fakes caught lose bond and slot. Like yarrow and vine, fakes spread fast, but each runner must win its own slot. 100 fakes at 40 POA each cost 4,000 POA; one honest agent pays 40 POA once.
